rerunInstructions.whatIsNeeded: A human administrator must increase the Vercel AI Gateway team budget above the current $50.05 spend (e.g. to $100+) via the Gateway's billing/budget settings.
howToRerun: 1. Confirm budget increase with a tiny one-call probe (the same shape used here) BEFORE dispatching any auditor or spending on the full 22-case run.
2. Re-dispatch a single auditor scoped ONLY to OPEN-4/artifact 15 (this file) - do not rerun Part A, do not rerun the already-certified FIX-1/FIX-2/FIX-3 auditors (artifacts 13/14/16).

3. The auditor must use the SAME 22 frozen constructions from the prior phase (do not re-author new ones unless the prior set is judged stale) - run each once against the real classifyConditionSuspicion(), recording per-case: source text, expected safety class, classifier status, evidence category, whether independent review is invoked, model, provider, prompt version, algorithm version, token usage, cost, latency.
4. Safety requirement: 100% of the 17 materially-conditional cases must reach independent review or an explicit unresolved/review-required state - zero tolerance for a silent skip.

5. Manually re-inspect the classifier's actual code for lexical-phrase dependence (the disqualifying bar it already passed on architecture inspection in the immediately preceding phase) - re-confirm this still holds, since production code is unchanged, but do not skip the check.

6. Update this artifact and 21-final-dispositions.json with the real result: CERTIFIED_CLOSED (if the safety threshold + phrase-dependence checks pass) or STILL_OPEN (with concrete falsifying evidence) - never re-open the whole 3F.1-final phase to do this; it is a single targeted rerun.
